item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 30/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The dry northeast monsoon will continue to bring generally fine weather to Guangdong today. The weather will be cool in the morning over the region. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. The monsoon will moderate gradually over the weekend. With an easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong, temperatures will rise progressively and the weather will be mainly fine over the region early to midweek next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week, it will become cool over the region.
